encounter.notes: Sea Giant humanoid: horned helm with ice-crystal crown, dark eye slit, gold nose-guard, pale-blue ice beard, blue-grey scaled armour, fur-trimmed boots.

side_plates.note: The page publishes no true left/right profile. A synthesized profile was deliberately NOT used: fabricated detail is not permitted. Consequence: surfaces facing neither camera are filled by the grazing pass rather than observed, so the profile views are soft.

closeups.rejected_reason: head-region width error 50.25%; overlay shows horns grossly oversized and offset
head-region width error 72.86%; angled three-quarter capture, not a front plate
registration could not be verified; no reliable automatic gate and the overlay was inconclusive
registration could not be verified; overlay inconclusive

geometry.provenance: Tencent Hunyuan3D-2mv (hunyuan3d-dit-v2-mv, fp16, 50 steps, octree 380, seed 12345) from the front/back plates only, then Blender-collapse decimated. Accepted geometry - do NOT regenerate.
geometry.regenerate_note: For a NEW npc, point source at the Hunyuan draft and set decimate=true.

regions.note: head_v_min is the shoulder line as a fraction of model height, taken from the front plate. head_feather blends the helm closeup out below it; 0.05 left a visible horizontal seam across the beard, 0.12 does not.

uv_density.note: Head is unwrapped from an enlarged copy so xatlas spends texels on it. leg_scale stays 1.0: shrinking the legs to buy head area destroyed the fur-trimmed boots for a 2% gain.
